chitchat: backs out of the flak gun's mechanism, torque wrench in his teeth, and grunts.
"Slagworks built her ugly so she'd take a hit and keep eating. I just keep the teeth in her."
description: A Slagworks fitter half-inside the flak gun's mechanism, soot-black and unbothered, a torque wrench clamped in his teeth. He drags the old gun back from the dead every time a strafing run kills it.

bye.text: They go back inside the mechanism.

root.text: They don't come out of the gun. "She fires because I keep her fed and mended. You're not helping — you're in the way. Move."

name: a Slagworks fitter
